tesamorelin-approval-answer.summary: Tesamorelin: the answer to “Is it an approved medicine?” now shows each country, including the US approval.
tesamorelin-approval-answer.detail: Before, the answer started with the status in a region this site no longer covers in English, and it did not say that tesamorelin is an approved medicine in the US. It now gives the answer for each country: approved in the US since 2010; approved in Canada in 2014, but no longer sold there since 2022; not approved in the UK or Australia. The dates come from the FDA and Health Canada and are shown, with their sources, in the status table on the page.

v1-publication.summary: The site went public on 23 October 2026, in English.
v1-publication.detail: This is where the log starts. Any later correction to a page will be listed above this entry, with its date and what changed.
